transcription_notes: The student's name, student identifier and fiche number are null on purpose: this file is published, and no view of the app reads them.
Course rows and rooms transcribed from visible page, not from the scrambled embedded PDF text.
Unfilled fields represented by JSON null.
Arrival and departure table cells contain no course assignments.

header.title: Calendrier scolaire 2026-2027

legend.visual: white day cell with superscript rotation number

legend.printed_label: Journées pédagogiques fixes à contenu et lieu déterminé par les enseignants

interpretation_notes: The small number beside each class date denotes the 1–9 timetable day. Rotation advances over 180 class days plus the January 22 pool pedagogical day and February 19 / May 21 school pedagogical days, based on the printed numbers before and after these dates.
Every visible date from July 2026 through June 2027 is represented, including weekends.
Nonclass and event markers have been read from the colored cell fills and drawn symbols.
The holiday count of 16 covers September 2026 through June 2027, not the separately circled July 1, 2026.
Conditional pedagogical days are treated as no-class days as shown on this published calendar; their status could depend on school decisions.

cross_reference.note: Match rotation_day to retrieve all four periods for a dated class day.
